journeys.name: settings/cutover
journeys.title: the first cutover date gates Add Account, survives reload and cancel, bounds the months, and moves later through a preview when nothing is dated before

steps.name: before a date, there is no Cancel and Add Account points to Budget
saving the first date keeps it on the Budget, then in Settings
a change cancelled by button or Escape keeps the date; a saved one moves it
Previous month stops at the cutover month
a later date with nothing dated before it moves through its preview
a date after today with nothing dated before it says the coming days’ bank transactions won’t come in

journeys.name: settings/later-start
journeys.title: a later cutover date opens a preview of the Starting Balances and budget it would leave; Cancel and Escape change nothing

steps.name: a later date opens a readable preview
Tab reads the preview top to bottom: Close, the lists that fold in, Cancel, then Move
halfway down the preview, its Cancel button is wholly on screen
Cancel and Escape close it and keep the date
a date after today says why it has no preview
on a 320 px phone, the preview with every list open stays within the screen

journeys.name: settings/later-move
journeys.title: confirming a later cutover date with Reconciled history needs its unlock, folds the history in, and Settings undoes it, on desktop and on 320 and 390 px phones

steps.name: reconcile Card and leave one earlier Checking row uncleared
the preview names the cleared-balance change and asks for the unlock
